milestone_brief:
### lean-verify-continuation-m1 — Thread env + proofState continuation ids through lean_verify

**Description.** Wire the leanprover-community/repl environment id and proof-state id through the `lean_verify` MCP tool so the pipeline can (a) pay `import Mathlib` once and reuse the environment (~700x on warm calls) and (b) step a proof incrementally. Opaque, per-spawn-generation-guarded tokens; fail-closed on stale/unknown/malformed ids; a new `tactic_step` mode. Governed by R3 verification-contract + trust-language policy (no fail-open, no bare trust token).

**Acceptance criteria.**
- [ ] `env` (str token) accepted on cmd modes; `proof_state` (str token) + `mode=tactic_step` accepted for stepping; both surfaced in output as opaque tokens.
- [ ] A stale token (generation mismatch), an unknown-id protocol reply, and a malformed token ALL fail closed (status=invalid-input, compilation_success=false) — never a false status:ok.
- [ ] TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped in lockstep across every server/schemas/*.json; EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 re-pinned; result schema conformance suite green.
- [ ] make test green (incl. requires_lean_repl against the Mathlib env), ruff clean.

**Complexity.** M/L
